summary: This topic explains how users can personalize their ERP dashboard by adding frequently used options as 'Quick Links' for faster access to daily tasks.
steps: Identify an ERP option that you use frequently (e.g., 'Collect Fee').
Locate the 'Quick Link' option on your dashboard or near the frequently used menu item.
Add the desired option as a quick link.
The added quick link will now appear on your dashboard, allowing direct access.
business_rules: Quick links are user-specific, meaning each user can customize their own set of links.
important_notes: An N number of links can be updated according to each user's preference.
questions: How can I add a quick link to my ERP dashboard?
Can I customize the quick links on my interface?
Where do I find the option to add quick links?
Are quick links visible to all users or just me?
